2025-01-25 templates / compiler / rendering
16f9420 9a6dc92 6915b94 4cce741

Fez began owning its template compiler

Replacing the early renderer gave Fez control over template semantics, errors, and the cost of each render.

<script>
  class {
    init() {
      this.state.filter = 'all'
      this.state.visible = []
      this.state.tasks = [
        { id: 1, title: 'Compile template', done: true },
        { id: 2, title: 'Morph DOM', done: false },
      ]
    }

    beforeRender() {
      this.state.visible = this.state.filter === 'all'
        ? this.state.tasks
        : this.state.tasks.filter(task => task.done)
    }
  }
</script>

{#if state.visible.length}
  <ul>
    {#each state.visible as task}
      <li key={task.id}>{task.title}</li>
    {/each}
  </ul>
{:else}
  <p>No matching tasks.</p>
{/if}
